name: frxe-desktop
description: Frxe Desktop for Windows, Linux and macOS
author: void

scripts.check: npm test && node --check web/core.mjs && node --check web/backend.mjs && node --check web/ui-primitives.mjs && node --check web/ui.mjs && node --check web/window-controls.mjs && node --check web/app.mjs
scripts.tauri:build:windows: npm run icons && tauri build --bundles msi
scripts.tauri:build:linux: npm run icons && tauri build --bundles deb,appimage
scripts.tauri:build:macos: npm run icons && tauri build --bundles dmg
